label: Merges waiting to deploy
means: Merges to main that change what deploys and that production does not hold right now.
goal_source: goal from DORA's elite band (2024 Accelerate State of DevOps Report, p. 13, dora.dev/research/2024/dora-report), deploys on demand, so none waits; near band: template default
source: state: npx wrangler deployments list --json and versions list --json from params.worker_dir (default the repo root), read-only; git log --first-parent params.branch (default origin/main) -- params.deploy_paths (default worker_dir)

params.comment: The deploy target: worker_dir (the Worker's folder with its Wrangler config; default the repo root), branch (default origin/main), deploy_paths (merges touching these ship; default worker_dir, or every merge when that is the root), repo (default GITHUB_REPOSITORY, then the origin remote). platform: "pages" reads GitHub Pages deploys through the GitHub API (quality/collectors/site/deploy-pages.mjs), with no rollback detection; worker_dir and deploy_paths then do not apply. Unset, Wrangler reads a Worker.

label: Oldest waiting merge
means: Hours the oldest merge that production does not hold has waited; 0 when none waits.
goal_source: goal from DORA's elite band (2024 Accelerate State of DevOps Report, p. 13, dora.dev/research/2024/dora-report), change lead time less than one day. Near is the high band's edge, one week
source: state: npx wrangler deployments list --json and versions list --json from params.worker_dir (default the repo root), read-only; git log --first-parent params.branch (default origin/main) -- params.deploy_paths (default worker_dir)

label: Latest deploy's time from merge to live
means: Hours from the earliest merge the latest deploy shipped to that deploy.
goal_source: goal from DORA's elite band (2024 Accelerate State of DevOps Report, p. 13, dora.dev/research/2024/dora-report), change lead time less than one day. Near is the high band's edge, one week. DORA times from commit; this times from merge to main
source: latest: npx wrangler deployments list --json and versions list --json from params.worker_dir (default the repo root), read-only; git log --first-parent params.branch (default origin/main) -- params.deploy_paths (default worker_dir)

label: Latest deploy failed
means: 1 when the latest deploy was rolled back or shipped a named regression; on Pages, when its deployment failed.
goal_source: goal from DORA's elite band (2024 Accelerate State of DevOps Report, p. 13, dora.dev/research/2024/dora-report), a 5% change fail rate, so the latest deploy should hold
source: latest: wrangler deployments (a rollback) and gh issue list --search "Regressed-by" in:body

label: Failed deploys, last 10
means: Share of the last 10 deploys rolled back or shipping a regression; on Pages, the github-pages deployments that failed.
goal_source: goal from DORA's elite band (2024 Accelerate State of DevOps Report, p. 13, dora.dev/research/2024/dora-report), a 5% change fail rate. Near is the high band, 20%
source: wrangler deployments (the 10 most recent, Wrangler's cap, so N = 10) and gh issue list --search "Regressed-by" in:body

label: Latest failure's time to restore
means: Hours from the latest failed deploy to its rollback or fix (on Pages, the next successful one); counts until restored.
goal_source: goal from DORA's elite band (2024 Accelerate State of DevOps Report, p. 13, dora.dev/research/2024/dora-report), failed deployment recovery time less than one hour. Near is the high band, less than one day
source: latest: wrangler deployments and gh issue list (closedAt of each Regressed-by issue)

label: CI minutes behind the latest deploy
means: Billed Actions minutes of the push to main the latest production deploy shipped, every workflow run on it.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: the CI of one push to main under 20 billed minutes; near: template default, twice that
source: latest: gh api actions/runs?head_sha=<deploy commit>&event=push and runs/{id}/jobs, each job rounded up to the minute (GitHub's billing docs)
